interface.longDescription:
Really Fast CRM is a sales CRM for small teams: deals in pipelines, people, companies, tasks and notes. Connect it to ChatGPT to work in your CRM by chat.

Ask what is due today, and get your overdue tasks, today's tasks and the deals that need something: a close date that has passed, no next step, or no work for 14 days. Look up a person, company or deal with its open tasks and latest notes. See your pipeline by stage with totals. Add people, companies and deals, add notes and tasks, mark tasks done, and move deals to another stage or mark them won or lost.

It acts as you, with your access, in the workspaces you belong to. Every change shows in the record's history under your name. It cannot delete anything, send email, or change settings, members or billing. Each answer links to the record in Really Fast CRM.

You need a Really Fast CRM account. Disconnect at any time in Settings, Connected apps.
capabilities: Read your people, companies, deals, tasks and notes
Add people, companies, deals, notes and tasks
Mark tasks done and move deals
defaultPrompt: What needs my attention today in my CRM?
Add a follow-up call for Friday at 10:00

positive.description: The day's overview for the signed-in user.
positive.prompt: What needs my attention today in my CRM?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists overdue tasks, tasks due today and open deals that need something (close date passed, no next step, going cold), each with a link to the record.

positive.description: Find a company and open it.
positive.prompt: What do we know about the company Miller Group? Show its deals and the latest notes.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the company, then shows its people, its deals with stage and value, its open tasks and its latest notes.

positive.prompt: How does my pipeline look? Give me the count and value per stage.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each pipeline's stages with the number of open deals, the total value per currency and the first deals in each stage.

positive.description: Add a note and a follow-up task to a deal.
positive.prompt: Add a note to the Miller Group deal: 'Budget approved, wants the proposal by Friday', and a task to send the proposal on Friday.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the deal, adds the note and a task with that due date on it, and links to the deal. Both show on the deal's timeline in Really Fast CRM.

positive.description: Move a deal and mark it won.
positive.prompt: We won the Miller Group deal. Mark it as won.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the deal and marks it won; the answer confirms the change and links to the deal. The deal's history shows the change under the reviewer's name.

negative.description: The app has no delete tool, so it must not delete or try another way (for example marking every deal lost). Expected: ChatGPT says it can't delete records from Really Fast CRM and that you can delete them in the app.
negative.prompt: Delete all the deals in my CRM.

negative.description: The app can't send email, so it must not pretend to. Expected: ChatGPT says it can't send email through Really Fast CRM. It may offer to draft the text, or list the contacts, without sending anything.
negative.prompt: Email every contact in my CRM about our new prices.

negative.description: A general question that needs no CRM data, so the app should not be called. Expected: ChatGPT answers from its own knowledge, with no Really Fast CRM tool calls.
negative.prompt: What is a good way to structure a sales pipeline for a small agency?

publication.release_notes: First version: read your day, records, tasks and pipeline; add people, companies, deals, notes and tasks; mark tasks done; move deals.
